global_rules: freeze task, solver, parent, evaluator and resource identities before substantive outcome access
novelty alone is not a positive outcome
retain no-transform, parent-win, regression, failed-invention and CANNOT_CHECK cases
historical tasks must enforce a solver-visible source cutoff before the target invention epoch
do not score historical similarity to a famous answer as functional validity
do not alter frozen P-A through P-D primary endpoints from these outcomes

jobs.title: exact synthetic generative-regime transformation benchmark
required_build: prospective binding of strongest parent transform baseline
jobs.claim_limit: framework/interface discriminator only; no new P-C mechanism claim
jobs.done_when: F2_PLUS_REGIME_INTERFACE is compared with CURRENT_F0, CURRENT_F2 and a faithfully bound strongest parent transform arm, or the missing parent is CANNOT_CHECK

jobs.title: time-sliced historical invention reconstruction
jobs.minimum_cohort: 12 matched pairs across six domain families
jobs.claim_limit: exploratory/descriptive unless independent cutoff and adjudication are complete
jobs.done_when: successful and non-successful cases are evaluated without post-event leakage and invention is separated from later adoption

jobs.title: held-out scientific regime-transformation transfer
jobs.gate: open only if GR10 shows a protected residual and GR20 does not attribute it to synthetic/surface effects
jobs.claim_limit: only stage eligible to support a result-bearing P-C regime-transform mechanism
jobs.done_when: independently certified predecessor-insufficient scientific cases show or refute incremental valid reach beyond current interfaces and strongest parents
